description: Get past price and volume bars for ONE option contract by its OCC symbol, active or expired, newest first: open, high, low, close, volume, VWAP and trades. A period without trades has no bar. timeframe is day (default, last 90 days), hour (last 7 days) or minute (last 4 days); startDate and endDate set another window, and history begins in early 2024. Plus receives bars 15 minutes after they end, Pro as they form; the Free plan is answered with an upgrade note. Open interest, greeks and bid/ask have no history; implied volatility history is GetOptionVolatilityHistory. US tickers only.

contract.description: OCC option symbol, active or expired, e.g. O:AAPL270617C00350000

endDate.description: Last date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

maxResults.description: Maximum bars to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

startDate.description: First date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default depends on timeframe)

timeframe.description: Bar size: day, hour or minute (default: day)

name: GetOptionContractHistory
title: Option Contract History
